title: Calendar of Events for Friday | Harrison Calendar | wvnews.com
text:
Through Oct. 31
Art exhibition at The Gallery, Mondays through Fridays, 10 a.m.-5 p.m., James & Law building, downtown Clarksburg. Artists: Lotus MacDowell, watercolors of landscapes, buildings of the area; Pam Martino, collage mono prints; Beth Keener Flanery, handcrafted handbags; Joel Dugan, murals, oil and acrylic paintings of landscapes, portraits, still lifes, florals and collages.
St. James Church Pita Piata Sale, $12. Baking Wednesdays and Thursdays, Oct. 14 through Nov. 19. Pick up at noon on baking days. Orders: Patty, 304-623-4085; June, 304-622-2808; Tonda, 304-622-3385.
Friday, Oct. 9
Little Lambs Closet Consignment Sale, 9 a.m.-6 p.m., Heritage Christian School, Bridgeport. Shop discounted kids’ gear, clothing and toys. Free admission. Supports local charities.
Washington Irving High School Class of 1958 breakfast, 11 a.m., FOP, in the Elite Room, Nutter Fort.
Clarksburg Lions Club meeting, noon-1 p.m., Brickside Bar & Grille, 101 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport. Guest speaker: Dr. Richard Hess, family medicine doctor in Grafton, also administers the West Virginia Young Musicians Fund. Details: President Patty Flanigan, 304-669-5011; Al Cox, 304-216-5251.
Saturday, Oct. 10
Gather for Good Dinner & Silent Auction at Best Western Bridgeport, 100 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport, starting at 5 p.m., with dinner served at 5:30 p.m. Event includes dinner, fellowship, silent auction, student spotlights and HCA leadership message in support of Hillside Christian Academy. Tickets: $55 per person or $300 for a table of six, available exclusively through HCA by calling 304-848-3800.
Little Lambs Closet Consignment Sale, 9 a.m.-1 p.m., Heritage Christian School, Bridgeport. Shop discounted kids’ gear, clothing, and toys. Free admission. Supports local charities.
Hot Dog Sale, 11 a.m.-5 p.m. or until sold out, Sardis Community Center. Proceeds benefit the many projects of the center.
Sagebrush Round-Up with The Round-Up Band, Joe and Melinda Hooker, Flannel And Company Band. Tickets $8 at door. Doors open at 4 p.m., dinner at 5 p.m., music at 6 p.m. At 2580 Bunner Ridge Road, Fairmont.
Sunday, Oct. 11
Free concert for military veterans, with Jessica Lynch making an appearance, Robinson Grand Performing Arts Center, Clarksburg. Doors open at 2 p.m.; concert starts at 3 p.m. Guests who aren’t military veterans pay $10. VFW Post 573 will hold a fundraising dinner at the nearby post afterward.
Monday, Oct. 12
Friends of the Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library meeting, 1 p.m., second floor Maxwell Meeting Room. All welcome. Cecelia Reid, 304-624-9860.
Enlarged Hepzibah PSD regular board meeting, 12:30 p.m., Sun Valley PSD office, 18 Sable Circle, Reynoldsville. Rhonda Beezel or Kevin Short, 304-623-2217.
Sun Valley PSD regular board meeting, 2:30 p.m., Sun Valley PSD office, 18 Sable Circle, Reynoldsville. Cathy Sparks, 304-623-9609.
No CENTRA bus service in Harrison County; employees will be undergoing mandatory safety training, according to the Central West Virginia Transit Authority.
Tuesday, Oct. 13
Stonewall Jackson Civil War Roundtable, 6:30 p.m., Waldomore, 404 W. Pike St., Clarksburg. Guest speaker: Steve French, prize-winning author and Civil War historian, on the topic “McNeill’s Rangers and the Capture of Generals Crook and Kelley, Feb. 21, 1865.” For more information, contact Pete Taylor at 304-476-3298. All are welcome to attend.
Harrison County Association of Retired School Employees luncheon, noon, St. Ann’s Catholic Church, Shinnston. Program: funeral planning. Bring non-perishable foods for the food pantries. For reservations: call Norma at 304-842-4213 or Mary Ann at 304-592-2061.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
October Fatima Rosary Rally, noon, Knights of Columbus Hall, 334 E. Pike St., Clarksburg.
NARFE Chapter 1579 meeting, 11:30 a.m., Brickside Grille, 101 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport. Guest speakers: Harrison Senior Center Executive Director Beth Fitzgerald; Clarksburg History Museum Marketing and Program Coordinator Beth Gain. They will discuss the two levy measures on the Nov. 3 General Election ballot. Details on NARFE: President Bill O’Field, 304-627-8175; Vice President Patty Flanigan, 304-669-5011.
Victory High School Class of 1966 bimonthly class dinner, 6 p.m., Twin Oaks. Details: Rita Bailey, 304-677-3201.
Wednesday, Oct. 14
Lost Creek & Johnstown Lions Clubs’ District Governor’s Night, 6:30 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Church, baked steak dinner by Paula Finster & Lost Creek UMC Women of Faith serving. Reservations required: Lion Greg Wriston, 304-203-0544.
Thursday, Oct. 15
Greater Harrison County PSD regular board meeting, 9 a.m., West Milford Community Building, North Liberty Street, West Milford.
Spelter Senior Citizens meeting, noon, Spelter Fire Department. Soups and crackers to be provided by five members of the Satellite; all other members bring sandwiches, salads or desserts. In conjunction with the Spelter Volunteer Fire Department and the Spelter Senior Citizens Satellite, the Harrison Clarksburg Health Department will be on site to give flu shots from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. The flu clinic is open to all residents of Harrison County and especially to those served by the Spelter Volunteer Fire Department. Sharon, 304-624-6251.
Friday, Oct. 16
Hot dog and bake sale, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., Vincent Memorial UMC, 401 Indiana Ave., Nutter Fort. Hot dog sale is eat in or carry out.
Saturday, Oct. 17
Lumberport High School Alumni quarterly meeting, 11 a.m., Lumberport United Methodist Church. Details: 304-826-7390.
West Milford Lions Club annual car show, West Milford Community Center. Registration 1-3 p.m.; car show 3-5 p.m. Registration cost: $15. Dash plaques for first 50 entries. Twelve trophies to be awarded. Multiple raffle baskets; door prizes. Hilda Clutter, 304-745-4778.
Celebrate Missions Fall Craft and Vendor Show, 9 a.m.-3 p.m., Duff Street MultiMinistry Building, 204 Baker Ave., Clarksburg. Hosted by the Duff Street United Women in Faith. Proceeds benefit mission projects.
Mamie’s Closet Clothing and Food Giveaway, 10 a.m.-1 p.m., Kelly Miller Community Center, 408 E.B. Saunders Way, Clarksburg. Meals will be provided. For questions, contact Cathy at 304-476-1434.
Monday, Oct. 19
VFW Post 573 House Committee meeting, gather at 6 p.m., meeting at 7 p.m., at the Post.
Tuesday, Oct. 20
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., IHOP, Bridgeport. 304-624-4262.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
Drop by Red Door Church (West Main & South 6th Street, Clarksburg) from 4–6:30 p.m. to ask Medicaid representatives about coverage, eligibility, or application assistance. Call 304-423-5049 for information/RSVP.
Wednesday, Oct. 21
Salem High School Class of 1969 monthly lunch meeting, noon, Bella’s Restaurant, Salem. Alumni, family, friends. 202-905-1959.
Monday, Oct. 26
Knights of Columbus Council 872 regular business meeting, 7 p.m., Council Hall, 334 E. Pike St., Clarksburg. All members encouraged to attend.
Tuesday, Oct. 27
Catholic Daughters of the Americas Court Clarksburg 334 meeting, 6 p.m., Immaculate Conception Parish Center. All Catholic women 18 years old and older invited to attend and learn about the court. Details: Theresa White, 304-669-6063.
Friday, Oct. 30
Military Order of Purple Heart Chapter 418 meeting, noon, IHOP restaurant in White Oaks section of Bridgeport. Commander Porter Southern, 304-584-5906; Senior Vice President Harold Wilson, 304-203-5856.
Monday, Nov. 2
Clarksburg Veterans Day Parade entries due to Meuse-Argonne Post VFW 573. Write to VFW Post 573, 430 W. Pike St., Clarksburg, WV 26301; call 304-622-3591; write vfwpost573@gmail.com; or visit the post’s Facebook site. The parade will be held Nov. 11.
Wednesday, Nov. 11
Veterans Day ceremony by Meuse-Argonne Veterans of Foreign War Post 573 and Auxiliary, 11 a.m., Jackson Square, Clarksburg. Veterans Day parade at noon. Free soup beans and cornbread at the VFW post after the parade.
summary: Event includes dinner, fellowship, silent auction, student spotlights and HCA leadership message in support of Hillside Christian Academy. Free concert for military veterans, with Jessica Lynch making an appearance, Robinson Grand Performing Arts Center, Clarksburg. No CENTRA bus service in Harrison County; employees will be undergoing mandatory safety training, according to the Central West Virginia Transit Authority. Guest speaker: Steve French, prize-winning author and Civil War historian, on the topic “McNeill’s Rangers and the Capture of Generals Crook and Kelley, Feb. 21, 1865.”
